title: Ltx2.3-VBVR: Visual Reasoning LoRA for LTX-Video
summary: A specialized LoRA adapter for the LTX-2.3 22B model that significantly improves physical reasoning, spatial logic, and temporal consistency in video generation. It utilizes the Video-Based Visual Reasoning dataset to reduce common AI video glitches and hallucinated physics.
research_notes: Specifically addresses gravity simulation, causal relationships, and object persistence; highly compatible with ComfyUI workflows.

evolution.summary: The project evolves from Stage 1 (96K videos) to Stage 3 (390K videos), introducing 'Hard Reasoning' for complex multi-object interactions. Future updates aim to scale training to the full 1-million video VBVR dataset for near-perfect physical accuracy.
